unresolved_research_gaps.summary: ASML primary evidence was refreshed and a scenario-complete research draft was written, but the required assessment upsert was rejected because valuation_template_rationale is valid only for the other template. The rejected command was not retried. The security row had already advanced, and a validated rollback attempt was then rejected as older research state. No assessment, follow-up operation, strategy, signal, order, allocation, or accounting state was created. Issue issue_f50e95ee4d3a5cc05618 records the partial-state reconciliation requirement, so the operation fails closed.
